_bbox_note: Waikiki from Kapahulu Ave to the Ala Wai harbour and Hilton Hawaiian Village, plus the east edge of Ala Moana (Hawaiki Tower).
_pending_note: 2026-10-08: drone Photo Spheres confirmed by a one-image screen (free metadata scan of 3506 points within 2 km of the towers, 619 user spheres; 20 screened; OSM roads did not load, so the road-distance score term is flat). Both are Reno Gregory 2021-02, ~40-60 m up over the Duke Kahanamoku lagoon / Hilton breakwater, 214-302 m from the Hilton Hawaiian Village towers, with the Waikiki row in view. Not captured: a 2-row hi-res sphere (15 headings x pitches 8/-18 = 30 images, free allowance, ~$0.21 at list price) each needs approval. Rob Brown 2023-12 (21.27898,-157.84012) is elevated but at night. Most other high scorers are boats (Trailview Studios 2024-10 track, Will M, a Hilton catamaran) or ground level.
_satellite_note: 2026-10-08 (Esri identify, free): World Imagery = Vantor WV02 2025-02-01 0.5 m (central Waikiki) and WV03 2025-05-11 0.31 m (Hilton Hawaiian Village): satellite, so towers lean (off-nadir not measured); Wayback holds >= 7 scenes: USGS 2006 aerial, WV02 2014/2016, WV04 2018-11-28, WV03 2020-09-29, WV02 2022-10-03, WV03 2024-01-14, 2025.
_truth_note: Survey-only truth, single source (2026-10-08): no Google 3D Tiles cross-check (monthly cap). Read from HI_NOAAMauiOahu_2_B20 (NOAA topobathy lidar, GPS-dated 2023-03-09 at Waikiki), the newest project here; the repo's project pick ranks it last (no year in its name) and would read USGS_LPC_HI_Oahu_2012_LAS_2015 (flown 2013-06-20), which predates Grand Islander (2017) and Ritz-Carlton Diamond Head (2018). 1102 footprints in runs/benchmark/truth/honolulu.json (18 of 52 strip tiles, tallest first; 207 footprints in S3-reset tiles still to read). Published vs survey on the named towers: 10 of the 12 read agree within 4.5 m; Grand Islander reads 112.7 (published 121.9) and Island Colony 116.7 (published 106.7).
